# v0.3.30 — Finding an earlier topic in Chinese

## What's changed

- **Earlier topics are found by what they are about, in Chinese too.** With more than 16 topics, TheOne first picks the 16 most likely ones for the classifier. That pick matched only whole titles, names and keywords, plus DSH's full-text search, which is off by default and does not split Chinese (a known DSH limitation, reported in its discussions #1999 and #8713). So "上次那家京都旅馆还有房吗" did not bring up a topic titled "十一月出游" whose summary mentions 京都 and 旅馆. The pick now also compares the words and two-character pieces of your message with each topic's description, giving more weight to what few topics share. Wording every topic has (我们, 项目, 进行中) pulls none of them forward. Nothing new is stored: only the topic descriptions TheOne already keeps are used.

TheOne only organises: it adds its own entries and views, and never changes your settings or your own chats.

Validation: automated tests (215) and type checks passed, including a catalog of 31 topics where the message shares no whole term with the right topic and DSH's full-text search finds nothing.

## 中文

- **用中文也能找回以前的话题。** 话题超过 16 个时，TheOne 会先挑出最可能相关的 16 个交给路由模型判断。以前挑选只看标题、人名地名和关键词是否整词出现，再加上 DSH 的全文搜索；而 DSH 的全文搜索默认关闭，并且不会切分中文（DSH 已知问题，见其讨论区 #1999、#8713）。所以「上次那家京都旅馆还有房吗」找不到标题叫「十一月出游」、摘要里写着京都和旅馆的话题。现在挑选时还会把你的话按词和两字片段与每个话题的描述比对，越少话题共有的片段权重越高；所有话题都有的说法（我们、项目、进行中）不会让任何一个话题靠前。不新存任何内容，只用 TheOne 本来就保存的话题描述。

TheOne 只做整理：它只添加自己的入口和视图，不改你的设置，也不改你自己的会话。

已通过自动化测试（215 项）和类型检查，其中包括一个 31 个话题的目录：消息和正确话题没有任何完整的词相同，DSH 全文搜索也搜不到任何结果。
